ruleset: Classic documented boot blessings: 5 qualifying actions; roam 600 Thriving unlock, 1500 scaling cap. Not asserted to be the live 2026 ruleset.

items.name: Bloody Retribution
items.description: Boots + Retribution required. After 5 actual creep/hero kills or hero assists, farm-target Retribution deals 150% damage; hero cast deals 100 True Damage plus steals 250 +20% extra HP over 4s. Legacy Liquipedia ruleset; does not occupy an equipment slot.

items.name: Flame Retribution
items.description: Boots + Retribution; unlock at 5 qualifying actions. Farm-target Retribution deals 150%; hero cast deals 100 True Damage and steals 58–100 Physical Attack and Magic Power for 4s, by level. Legacy Liquipedia ruleset; not an ordinary purchase.

items.name: Ice Retribution
items.description: Boots + Retribution; unlock at 5 qualifying actions. Farm-target Retribution deals 150%; hero cast deals 100 True Damage and steals 72–100 Movement Speed for 4s, by level. Legacy Liquipedia ruleset; not an ordinary purchase.

items.name: Conceal
items.description: Roam setup + boots, incompatible with Retribution. Devotion restricts shared farming for first 8min; Thriving unlocks at 600 earned role Gold. Active: nearby allied heroes gain camouflage and 24%–60% Movement Speed for 5s; damage breaks camouflage. 80s cooldown. Classic rules, not a live-patch claim.

items.name: Dire Hit
items.description: Roam setup + boots; unlock after 600 Thriving Gold, scaling capped at 1500. Damaging heroes below 35% HP adds 7%–18% target Max HP hybrid damage, once per 30s. Explicit classic execute version, not the disputed newer movement-stack/mark reworks.

items.name: Encourage
items.description: Roam setup + boots; unlock after 600 Thriving Gold. Nearby allied heroes gain 12–30 Physical Attack and Magic Power and 15% Attack Speed; scaling cap 1500 role Gold. Classic offensive aura, not the conflicting newer defensive rework.

items.name: Favor
items.description: Roam setup + boots; unlock after 600 Thriving Gold. A non-self-only healing/shield skill heals the lowest-HP allied hero within 5 units for 480–1200; 15s cooldown. Self-only Aegis, lifesteal and regeneration do not trigger Favor; Revitalize can. Classic rules.

items.name: Flower of Hope
items.description: Floryn-granted allied equipment only; not a free shop item. Floryn is not in this prototype, so this reference-only entry cannot be acquired, equipped, sold or put into a Layla build. No bonuses applied.

items.name: Lantern of Hope
items.description: Floryn-exclusive permanent equipment, obtained by her passive, never purchased or sold. Only Layla is playable here; this reference entry is unavailable and grants no stats.
